picks.title: 不存在的罪人
picks.summary: 影片改编自柯琳·胡佛的同名畅销小说。知名作家维莉蒂因故无法完成新作，潦倒作家洛温受邀前往其偏远庄园代笔，却意外发现维莉蒂诡异的自传手稿。面对其中关于丈夫杰里米的扭曲告白，洛温逐渐难辨虚实、操控与诱惑。
picks.summaryEn: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing trut

picks.title: 万人之上：冬攀乔戈里峰
picks.summary: 一场历史性的竞赛，试图成为冬季首位登顶 K2 峰的人，最终演变成悲剧，暴露出野心、自我和对荣耀的追求可能与这座山峰本身一样危险。
picks.summaryEn: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

picks.title: 潜伏6：血域
picks.summary: 三名潜行者悄然入侵静谧的郊区，将一户新搬来的家庭困于灵薄狱的夹缝之中。他们原以为这只是场残酷的猎杀游戏，却在此撕裂了现实与异界的边界——一个令人战栗的真相逐渐浮现：深渊彼岸的“灵薄狱”，正从裂缝中不断渗入现实世界。
picks.summaryEn: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

picks.title: 起义
picks.summary: 在中世纪的英格兰，一位无畏的勇士召集平民发动了一场激烈的起义，反抗国王理查德二世的高压统治。随着国家陷入混乱，他的起义军与王室军队展开了一场绝望的自由之战。
picks.summaryEn: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

picks.title: 误杀瞒天记3
picks.summary: 《误杀瞒天记3》延续《误杀瞒天记》系列脉络，围绕Salgaonkar家族掩盖谋杀事件展开叙事。
picks.summaryEn: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save hi

picks.title: 哈奴曼化身
picks.summary: 一个悲伤的男孩寻求上帝，希望能与他逝去的母亲重逢。在追寻神性的过程中，他学会用爱、食物和无声的祝福的奇迹来服务人类，最终成为哈奴曼化身——尼姆·卡罗利·巴巴。
picks.summaryEn: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.
